csv_scope_of_work: Architectural and engineering services of a 36CFR61 qualified Historic Architect for the assessment, design, and probable construction cost to address failed and/or deteriorated and stressed masonry of the historic furnace stacks at Fayette Historic State Park. title: Architectural Services for Fayette Historic State Park - Furnace Stacks
short_description: Historic architect and engineering services for masonry assessment and design at furnace stacks.
project_scope: Assessment, design, and probable construction cost estimation for failed, deteriorated, and stressed masonry of the historic furnace stacks at Fayette Historic State Park. The assignment includes Phase 100 Study, Phase 300 Design Services, and Phase 400 Preliminary Design for a historic preservation project.
services: Architectural and engineering services by a 36 CFR 61 qualified Historic Architect; condition assessment, design, and probable construction cost preparation for historic masonry furnace stacks.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a historic preservation and architectural masonry assessment project.
- No bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or structurally innovative special structure scope is indicated.
- Services are limited to architecture/historic architect qualifications rather than structural engineering leadership.
- Small stated contract value suggests limited engineering scope and low strategic relevance for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender documents. Only the service contract value of 12200 USD is provided. The scope concerns masonry repair assessment and design for historic furnace stacks, but no quantities, dimensions, or repair extent are given, so a realistic construction cost estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Bidder must provide architectural and engineering services of a Historic Architect qualified under 36 CFR 61.
